ELECTROFORCE® LOAD FRAME AND TESTBENCH INSTRUMENTS
Product catalog summary
Overview
ElectroForce® test instruments leverage patented linear motion technologies and WinTest® controls for mechanical fatigue and dynamic characterization. They are designed for diverse applications, ensuring reliable performance with precision and user-friendliness.
ElectroForce® Load Frames
Available in various models, these load frames offer different force and performance capabilities, allowing precise control of force, displacement, or strain over a wide frequency range.
ElectroForce TestBenches
These versatile TestBenches can be configured for various testing needs, including planar biaxial testing with video extensometers.
Instrument Features
Key features include a frictionless linear motor, efficient electromagnetic conversion, intuitive software, and standard electrical outlet compatibility. They are energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, and suitable for clean-room operations.
Linear Motor Technology
The ElectroForce linear motor provides unmatched waveform control and fidelity, operating in diverse environments with options for extended stroke.
Software Technology
The software offers comprehensive control and data analysis, including advanced limit monitoring and conditional logic features, supporting dynamic mechanical analysis with high-speed real-time measurements.
Load Frame Instruments
3100 Model: Compact and portable, ideal for precise force and displacement control.
5500 Model: Open architecture for adaptability, suitable for academic labs.
3200 Series: High precision and versatile, with torsion and extended stroke options.
3300 Series: Flexible with multiple loading ranges, suitable for various materials and devices.
3500 Series: High force capabilities for strength and dynamic characterization tests.
Applications and Accessories
Suitable for various applications, with accessories to simulate different environments and enhance data quality.
Specifications
Each model has specific force, displacement, and frequency ranges, along with dimensions and weight details.
Instrument Dimensions and Weight
Dimensions and weights for various configurations are provided in metric and imperial units, with weights in kilograms and pounds.
TestBench Instruments
The TestBench series is a versatile platform allowing relocation and orientation of motors and force sensors in multiple configurations, featuring precise control and interchangeable force sensors.
Planar Biaxial Instruments
Designed for planar samples like membranes and textiles, featuring two or four 200 N ElectroForce linear motors for precise loading, with interchangeable force sensors and power amplifiers.
Applications
Testing techniques include tension/compression, bending, torsion, shear, fatigue, applicable across industries such as medical devices, biomaterials, automotive, and aerospace.
Accessories and Options
A wide range of accessories is available, including grips, sensors, fixtures, and chambers, with upgrade options like axial torsion, extended stroke, and pulsatile features.
Specifications
Detailed specifications for different models include force range, displacement, frequency, and options for thermal chambers and fluid baths.
Global Presence
TA Instruments has a global presence with support staff in 24 countries across five continents, emphasizing their commitment to customer support and service.
